notes.title: New VN: Pale Cachexia!
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/6d9215144257e2544f27ded9d4e33a6c54c84ceb.jpg[/img]

[h1]Announcing AG's newest VN: A Gothic fantasy story called 
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/847680/Pale_Cachexia/?beta=1]Pale Cachexia![/url]

Demo Release: December 2020

Full Game Release: Q1 2021[/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/847680/Pale_Cachexia/?beta=1

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/e8eef48cdcb49e7854b9495e48ad995f84f4e2ab.png[/img]

In this Gothic story of deep bonds and chilling mystery, [b]a young girl named Esther[/b] ventures deep within a forgotten forest.

There, she seeks out a potential cure for her mysterious illness: 
a life-leeching plague known as [b]the Pale Cachexia.[/b]

But when Esther meets [b]Seina,[/b] who lives all alone in a towering manor, the two girls are drawn to each other in a tale of friendship, sorrow, and bitter loneliness.

Their story is shadowed by the dark secrets of the manor and its [b]cemetery[/b], which haunts Esther even in her deepest dreams.

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/b4e70a51233bcc9e96c4616ad054b5b3ce7f1d29.png[/img]
[list][*] [b]Genres:[/b] Kinetic novel, Gothic fantasy, drama, horror
[*] [b]Rating:[/b] PG-13 (language/mild horror)
[*] [b]Endings:[/b] Linear
[*] [b]Estimated Length:[/b] 60k-80k words
[*] [b]Estimated Release:[/b] Q1 2021[/list]
[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/7bbc2bd9ed1b21b637326db399f07db20a94d2fa.png[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/e8979e2c9c7a38f3e325545311a250a63e4f49c7.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/a6abfc23b80672d4ba320c6dc26ae1d65c0f0d2d.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/ec628676a54db68e1c3ab0998700006d1ae8636f.jpg[/img]

[img]https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/79c861672110ddc93a1cf7450f6b0925b08e7134.png[/img]

[h1]Other Info[/h1]
[list][*] [b]A short demo[/b] is planned for release this month
[*] The game is planned as a (relatively) short project to experiment with storytelling and new VN techniques
[*] As with all our Ren’Py games, it will release on Windows/Mac/Linux and Android[/list]

And that’s it for the big announcement! If you have any particular questions, [url=https://discord.com/invite/p3pM8rj][b]join us on Discord[/b] [/url]or check out our [url=https://www.twitch.tv/argent_games][b]weekly dev streams on Twitch[/b][/url] every Saturday, starting at 7:30 AM PST/10:30 AM EST! Thanks so much for all of your amazing support, and stay safe out there!

notes.title: Self-Checkout Unlimited Now on Kickstarter!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/argentgames/self-checkout-unlimited-a-3d-mall-adventure][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/1325d78c45c8941a3ac065ecb2430fe30c93f087.jpg[/img][/url]

[h2]We just launched the Kickstarter for our latest game, [u][b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/argentgames/self-checkout-unlimited-a-3d-mall-adventured]Self-Checkout Unlimited! [/url][/b][/u][/h2]

[u][b][url=https://argent-games.itch.io/self-checkout-unlimited]Check out the demo,[/url][/b][/u] available on both Windows and Mac!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/949b14fd40943965a2409be579ceba3378ceaed9.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/7485eb0a88a15812a07dfa222eaa95211bfc7488.png[/img]

An empty shopping mall after closing time.

Lost and alone inside a picture-perfect labyrinth.

As sunset slowly approaches, navigate between surreal stores to find the exit key, with only two cheerful PA announcers to keep you company. Can you unravel the mystery of your journey before it's time to say goodbye?

"Thank you for choosing Wilson Center Mall—a single stop for everything you'll ever need!"

❤

Inspired by the 8-circuit model of consciousness, the mallsoft genre, and the book Angel Tech by Antero Alli, Self-Checkout Unlimited is a unique exploration of both mind and matter.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/bbd4e38e21adfa56be771ef7175844dfe9bc22c5.jpg[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/cd767e7993b5b28d8a9df0472a79364ee7ef088b.png[/img]

Genre: Adventure, exploration, philosophical, surreal
Length: Short (~1-2 hrs, replayable)
Est. Release: Summer 2020

-Different story elements and endings based on your choices
-"Free Mall" mode—upon completion of the main game, explore the full mall freely without the story
-An original soundtrack inspired by nostalgic mall jazz and surreal dreamy synthscapes

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33052059/b43323f5ad9a1b6680ba3ccfc53f865225b71bd1.jpg[/img]

You can find SCU's Steam page below, along with more details about our surreal new 3D adventure.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1221320/SelfCheckout_Unlimited/

notes.title: Red Embrace: New BL Game Release!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/796940/Red_Embrace/][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29096909/d3a2251dc3fbdcdba64f1b4a65d626f24ca9fdae.jpg[/img][/url]

[h1]We've just released a new BL game on  [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/796940/Red_Embrace/][b]Steam[/b][/url], [url=https://argent-games.itch.io/red-embrace][b]Itch[/b][/url], and [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.argentgames.redembrace][b]Google Play![/b][/url][/h1]

For those of you who haven't heard, we launched our latest yaoi project, Red Embrace, on various platforms yesterday! 

It's a vampire-themed romance/drama VN set in modern day San Francisco. If you're interested, [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/796940/Red_Embrace/]make sure to check it out![/url] See the summary and features below!

----

[b]Summary:[/b]

[i]The graveyard shift at a dingy diner in San Francisco – that’s where MC’s story begins.  It’s just another normal night, or at least it seems to be. 

…That is, until a certain mysterious customer stops by, bringing the dangerous attention of a few people with him. When it rains, it pours, and suddenly MC finds himself in the middle of a war he didn’t even know existed… between vampires.

How does MC react to the dark, violent world that opens up before him? That’s up to you![/i]

[b]Features:[/b]

► Genre: Drama, BxB romance, dark modern
► Length: ~45,000 words
► Endings: 6 

► Changeable MC personality & interests
► Different dialogue & choices based on personality
► 11 track OST with a dark, urban vibe
► 10 CGs

-----

Thanks again for your support!

Follow us on [url=https://twitter.com/argent_games]Twitter[/url] for regular updates, join our community on [url=https://discordapp.com/invite/5SrFgVY]Discord[/url] to chat with fellow yaoi fans, and support us on [url=https://www.patreon.com/argentgames]Patreon[/url] for extras and bonuses!

notes.title: Requiescence Anniversary (Goodies, SALE!)
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/RsJqJZol.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy Birthday, Req![/h1]

Exactly one year ago today, we released our first visual novel into the world – Requiescence! It’s pretty hard to believe; we’ve come a long way since then and learned so much during development that Requiescence seems like a distant memory. Now, as we prepare to release our second game within the next couple of months, the two of us at Argent Games wanted to celebrate Req’s birthday with a few goodies.

For one day only, [url=https://argent-games.itch.io/requiescence][b]Requiescence is available at 50% off on Itch.io![/b] [/url] If you’ve wanted to give it a try but never had a chance to purchase the game, here’s your golden opportunity! (There is also a Steam Key included, so you can get in your library here as well!)

We’ve also released the [b][u]character backstories[/u][/b] for the very first time. In the game itself, the love interests discuss their own histories to a limited extent, so if you’ve ever been curious about Kaul and Carrault’s spicy past or Damian’s inner turmoil, you can [url=https://argent-games.itch.io/requiescence][b]download the free PDF on our Itch page![/b][/url]

Finally, the [url=https://argent-games.itch.io/requiescence][b]Requiescence artbook – formerly only attainable through Kickstarter – is now also available on Itch![/b][/url] It contains some sketches and WIPs, along with a few lore tidbits and fun behind-the-scenes snippets.

A giant thank-you to everyone who supported us during Req’s development back in 2016. Without you, we wouldn’t have been able to make Chess of Blades – a project with much more art, voice acting, and higher production quality all around! Req lifted Argent Games off the ground, and we plan to keep improving the quality of our projects with each new release.

notes.title: New game, art position open on team, official Discord server
notes.content:
Heyo! It's been a little over a year since we first began Requiescence, and we are excited to announce that we are working on our next BL VN! Codenamed [b]CAN[/b] (since names are hard). We plan on sprinting through this project and bringing it to Kickstarter/Greenlight. We also have community events to get YOU involved in the development process. Visit our [url=http://blog.argentgames.co/post/155997443162/new-game-in-progress-can-you-see-it]dev blog[/url] for more details.

Quick (for now..) summary: Rivian, the son of a famous nobleman, attends the huge birthday celebration of the king! Dancing, drinking, and flirting abound.
